{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–6 (Players Committee PDF slips). It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 6]] and not a GEMP environment.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS6''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] and [[Reflections III]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–6. [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds|Virtual Set 6]] (City In The Clouds): Released late 2003 or early 2004.<ref name="vs6">[[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]]</ref> The short name '''POVS6''' is used in GEMP importable deck file names.

Wiki decklists use this format when the newest original-era virtual card in the list comes from Virtual Set 6.
